skills.name: fetch-page-markdown
skills.description: Fetch Niksy HTML pages as Markdown via HTTP content negotiation (Accept: text/markdown). Use when reading documentation from this site for agent context.

skills.name: nix-glossary
skills.description: Look up Nix/NixOS terms in Niksy's Persian glossary JSON. Use when translating or explaining terminology (English or Persian) for Nix, NixOS, flakes, derivations, nixpkgs, etc.

skills.name: nixy-docs
skills.description: Browse and cite Persian Nix/NixOS documentation on Niksy (نیکسی). Use when answering questions about Nix, NixOS, nix.dev guides, the Nix manual, Nixpkgs, Tour of Nix, or Persian terminology for this site.
